subject: general
question: The 74th Constitutional Amendment Act provides for ______ for a transitional area between a rural and urban area.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Nagar Panchayat'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 74th Amendment Act of 1992 provides for the constitution of the following three types of municipalities in every state:

 
• **Nagar Panchayat -** For Transitional area, i.e., an area in transition from a rural area to an urban area.
 
• **Municipal Council- **For smaller urban areas that is an area of population of more than 100,00.
 
• **Municipal Corporation- **For larger urban area that is an area of population of more than 1 million.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**74th Amendment Act of 1992:**

 
• This act added a new** Part IX-A- 'The Municipalities' **to the constitution of India.
 
• The new part consists of provisions from **Articles 243-P to 243-ZG.**
 
• The Act also added a new** Twelfth Schedule** to the constitution.
 
• This Schedule contains 18 functional items of municipalities and deal with **Article 243-W.**
